prompt: Photorealistic product rendering on plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop, isometric front three-quarter view, eye-level slightly above. Center: white PIR insulated cold box about doorway tall and about van-width wide, standing on six small square concrete pads with galvanized frame and screw anchors on a small cleanly cut patch of compacted ground. Front 900mm insulated door swung open with clear PVC strip curtain parted, revealing two steel rack rows holding stacked vented plastic crates filled with fresh produce at hand-carry size. Rear-high monoblock cooler box mounted high on back outside wall with shaded condenser and sealed penetration, blowing cold air forward high over crates with low warm return. Left side beside box: vented steel battery cabinet with charge controller wired to cooler. Roof: low gantry holding 2 tilted dark-blue PV modules with vent gap; to the right and slightly behind on separate low galvanized ground frame, 7 matching tilted PV modules in a row. Small thermostat box on front wall beside door with thin probe cables into return air and into produce. Daylight operating moment, crisp product-shot lighting, real materials - glossy PV glass, white steel facers, galvanized tubes, matte concrete, green-red produce. Familiar scale read from door height and hand-carry crates. Clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each focus part, no other text in image.

visual_plan.view: Isometric front three-quarter, slightly elevated, showing open door and interior racks, roof array, side ground array, rear cooler, side battery and pads in one system view.
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Chamber centered on pads. Two PV modules centered on roof gantry above chamber with vent gap. Seven-module ground array on low frame to right-rear, same tilt, clearly separate. Battery cabinet immediately left of chamber. Monoblock on rear wall high. Open door at front-center revealing two longitudinal rack rows of crates. Thermostat on front wall beside door. Pads under chamber and under ground frame on single ground patch cut off at backdrop.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Bright daytime operation with door just opened for staged loading, full complement of produce crates inside with air gaps, monoblock blowing cold forward high to low return to hold near 5C, battery charging while powering cooler, thermostat actively regulating.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Energy: split solar array makes DC -> MPPT to battery bank -> battery powers monoblock compressor and fans -> cooler blows cold forward over crates and warm air returns low. Signal: return-air sensor and produce probe -> thermostat -> switched power to cooler with load shed.
visual_plan.interactions: PV modules bolt to roof gantry and separate ground frame; ground frame and chamber each bolt to own concrete pads with screw anchors; battery cabinet cables to monoblock cooler; cooler discharges high forward jet across top of crate stacks and returns low; thermostat probes sample air and produce and switch cooler; door plus strip curtain retains cold while allowing single-crate access; racking holds crates off walls with air gaps for circulation.
